name: How long does kitchen wall removal take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen wall removal take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen wall removal depends on several factors, including whether the wall is load-bearing, the need for structural engineering, permit acquisition time, and the complexity of associated repairs. A non-load-bearing wall removal might take a few days for demolition and basic finishing. A load-bearing wall project, including engineering, permits, structural modifications, and extensive finishing, could take several weeks. Permit approval times are a significant factor that can delay the start of physical work, highlighting a process clarity detail.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timeline depends on load-bearing status, engineering, permits, and repair complexity. Permit approval times are a key factor affecting duration.
